purpose: Teach: 小早川/クルド/佐渡/サハリン/対馬/府警/カーネル/オナニー

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦国武将小早川氏ゆかりの医療史を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're going to research the medical history connected to the Kobayakawa clan with the medical team.
lines.style: Direct, measured delivery. Even pace, no inflection. Professional announcement tone — stating fact, not seeking reaction.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、在日クルド人医療支援を医療チームで継続します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be continuing our medical support work for Kurdish residents with the team.
lines.style: Same steady pace. Slight emphasis on 'continuing' — this is ongoing work, not new. Clear, unhurried.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、佐渡島の僻地医療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, we're taking on rural medical care for Sado Island with the medical team.
lines.style: Even delivery, same professional composure. A touch more weight on the responsibility, but voice stays level.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、サハリンとの医療技術交流を医療チームで継続します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be continuing medical technology exchange with Sakhalin through the team.
lines.style: Consistent, steady tone. Clear pronunciation. No rush — giving him space to absorb each assignment.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、対馬の救急医療搬送体制を医療チームで整えます
lines.en: Ren, we're establishing an emergency medical transport system for Tsushima with the team.
lines.style: Same measured pace. 'Establishing' lands with slight emphasis — this is framework-building work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、府警捜査一課と医療チームで連携します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be coordinating with the prefectural police investigative unit through the medical team.
lines.style: Brief pause before 'police' — this is institutional, formal. Voice stays steady and composed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、電子カルテのカーネル更新を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Ren, we're managing the electronic medical record kernel update with the medical team.
lines.style: Technical language delivered with same calm clarity. No condescension — factual assignment.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、思春期のオナニーに関する性教育を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be providing sex education about adolescent development with the medical team.
lines.style: No shift in tone or pace. Clinical matter-of-factness — this is medical education, treated same as other assignments. Slight vocal closure at end.
